name: YMCA of San Francisco Workforce Development (Teens)
what_you_do: Teens 14 and older build job skills, get job readiness training and certifications, and may get paid internships and job placements. What is offered varies by YMCA branch.
who_can_apply: The page lists the program for ages 14 to 24 and older. Grade level, residency and other rules are not stated.
pay_detail: Paid internships are mentioned at the Urban Services YMCA. Wage and hours are not stated. Other activities are not described as paid.
how_to_apply: Not stated on the page. The page says to contact the Workforce Development team. Phone numbers listed: Urban Services YMCA (415) 561-0631; Bayview Hunters Point YMCA (415) 822-7728; Chinatown YMCA (415) 576-9622.
notes: This is an umbrella page for several branch programs. Season, wage, hours and deadlines are not stated, so call a branch before a teen applies. The ymcasf.org/teens page lists teens ages 13-18 across programs, but it gives no details for Workforce Development. Contact emails on the page are obfuscated and were not confirmed, so none are listed.
